sources.title: Qwen3 Technical Report - arXiv.org
sources.snippet: In this work, we introduce Qwen3, the latest series in our foundation model family, Qwen. Qwen3 is a collection of open-weight large language models (LLMs) that achieve state-of-the-art performance across a wide variety of tasks and domains.

sources.title: Qwen3 - lmstudio.ai
sources.snippet: The latest version of the Qwen3 model family, featuring 4B, 30B, and 235B dense and MoE models, both thinking and non-thinking variants.

sources.title: Qwen 3 — Alibaba's Most Powerful AI Model - Singularity Moments
sources.snippet: The 32B model requires a 24GB GPU or two smaller cards with tensor parallelism. For production deployments, vLLM offers high-throughput serving with continuous batching. Qwen 3 is also available on Together AI, Fireworks AI, and Alibaba's own DashScope API for those preferring managed inference.
